activity_summary: Master Thwaite preached the entry into Jerusalem as the fickleness of crowds, and he looked at nobody. He said there had been no palms in that church these thirty years. You sat in the south aisle and wrote nothing. Sir John Spencer was in the full Mayor's pew and did not speak. You kept your mind on a king riding in behind another man, and on the dust thrown on his head.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused to write in church, and held the other king's entry until later.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Preached the fickle crowd, named thirty years without palms, and looked at nobody.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Kept the aisle a parish, and forbade a note on the knee.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Said the Mayor's pew was full, and that the ledge was bare.

entities.name: Sir John Spencer
entities.context: Sat in the Mayor's pew with his hand on the door, and did not speak.

quotes.speaker: josias_thwaite
quotes.text: Consider who cry Hosanna on the Sunday.

quotes.speaker: josias_thwaite
quotes.text: There have been no palms in this church these thirty years.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I have written nothing. I mean to leave with nothing written.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: You will not make a note on your knee in my parish.
